answer.description: A string, a list of strings, a list of pairs (q3), or null when you do not answer.

ref.description: org/repo:path:line, for example acme/example-repo:README.md:3. The line number is the one that read_file_lines printed (it starts at 1).

quote.description: Text copied exactly from the cited line. At least 6 characters after the spaces at its start and end are removed ('  push:' has 5: too short). The text must appear on one line only in that file; if it repeats, quote a longer part of the line.

not_verified.description: Questions that you could not answer from the files. Give no answer for them.
